# Autumn Transition

The leaves descend in copper spirals down,
While summer's warmth retreats to memory.
The shortened days paint gold across the town,
And geese write farewells across the sky, free.
Yet in this gentle fading, beauty's found—
The earth prepares for rest on frozen ground.
